body:
Miami, Booth 344, and the Future of Guest Experience

This September, hospitality’s most forward-thinking hoteliers will gather in Miami for the Independent Hotel Show — and yes, DialZero will be there. Booth 344 is where you’ll see how instant, AI-powered guest communication can save your hotel thousands every year. (One NYC property saves $40,000 annually using DialZero.)

The Independent Hotel Show Miami isn’t just another industry event. It’s where new ideas meet real-world solutions, and where we get to show hoteliers exactly how to improve guest satisfaction and protect the bottom line.

Here’s what we’ll be highlighting at Booth 344:

  • AI-Powered, Multilingual Chat – Guests can get instant answers in their language of choice, no downloads, no confusion.
  • Automatic Task Routing – Requests go straight to the right team — housekeeping, maintenance, front desk — without human bottlenecks.
  • Streamlined Operations & Task Management – Track, assign, and close tasks in real time, all from one intuitive dashboard.

We could go on, but we’d rather show you in person.

Why Miami Makes It Better:
There’s something about Miami in September — the energy, the light, the fact that you can discuss guest engagement strategies one minute and be steps from the ocean the next. It’s the perfect backdrop for talking about what’s next in hospitality.

Mark Your Calendar:
📍 Booth 344
📦 September 17–18, 2025
📍 Miami Beach Convention Center

Whether you’re a boutique hotel owner, a GM of a luxury property, or just a hospitality pro who wants to see what’s possible, come say hi. We’ll make it worth the stop.
